title: Swap onto the free runner
text: It's about to come in. What do you do?
tip: Look around before the cross. If a mate already has your player, find the runner nobody has.

options.why: The look showed a mate already on your player and a runner alone nearer goal. Take that runner.

options.text: Get goal side of your player
options.why: You do your own job, but two of you mark one player and the runner is left.
Watching only the ball lets the runner arrive alone.

scan.prompt: A cross is about to come in from the wing. Check before it's hit.
